_readme: 通用作品內頁（projects/case.html?id=作品 id）的資料，文字整理自 Notion 作品集。overview：專案概述；challenge：關鍵挑戰；role：我負責的部分；links：外部連結。每章 layout：one＝一張一列、2＝兩張並排、3＝三張並排；photo=true 圖片滿版；videos＝YouTube 影片 [影片 ID, 標題, 封面圖檔名]。圖片放在 assets/img/case/。

digital-signage.badge: VIA 智慧城市 · 提案
digital-signage.en: Animal Shelter — Interactive Zone & Digital Signage Proposal
digital-signage.overview: 2018–2021 年在 VIA 智慧城市部門負責數位看板的客戶提案，把硬體規格轉成空間配置與應用情境，涵蓋商場、文化場館、醫療與辦公等場域。這裡以板橋流浪動物之家為代表案例：收容動物多、空間與人力有限，收容品質與領養效率都面臨挑戰，因此與館方一起提出互動與看板的改善方案，也推廣生命教育。
digital-signage.challenge: 收容所空間有限、動物數量龐大，民眾對收容中心的既有印象也需要改變；方案要在不增加人力的前提下，提高民眾認識與認養的意願。
role: 實地場勘，與負責人溝通需求與空間條件
規劃產品導入方式，用 3D 建模與示意圖呈現提案
與互動設計團隊一起制定生命教育的互動體驗

chapters.title: 場勘
chapters.text: 實地記錄犬舍、走道與現有告示，作為設備位置與動線規劃的依據。

chapters.title: 提案規劃
chapters.text: 在平面圖上劃出寵物挑選區與互動體驗區，對應犬舍與幼犬舍的位置。

chapters.title: 寵物挑選區
chapters.text: 成犬舍與幼犬舍分別設置看板與鏡頭，民眾可以即時看到毛寶貝；「每月之星」推薦優先認養。

chapters.title: 互動體驗區
chapters.text: 以 VR 頭戴裝置與大螢幕呈現毛寶貝的生活情境，讓民眾在認養前先認識牠們。

en_content.overview: From 2018 to 2021 in VIA's Smart City division, I handled digital signage proposals for clients, turning hardware specs into space plans and use scenarios for malls, cultural venues, healthcare and offices. The featured case is the Banqiao animal shelter: many animals, limited space and staff, and pressure on both care quality and adoption rates. Together with the shelter, we proposed interactive and signage improvements that also promote life education.
en_content.challenge: Space was tight, the number of animals was large, and the public's existing image of shelters needed to change. The proposal had to raise interest in meeting and adopting animals without adding staff.
role: Surveyed the site and discussed needs and space constraints with the person in charge
Planned how the products would be deployed, presenting the proposal with 3D models and mockups
Designed the life-education interactive experience with the interaction design team

chapters.title: Site Survey
chapters.text: Documented kennels, aisles and existing signs as the basis for equipment placement and visitor flow.

chapters.title: Proposal Plan
chapters.text: Marked a pet selection zone and an interactive zone on the floor plan, matched to the adult and puppy kennels.

chapters.title: Pet Selection Zone
chapters.text: Screens and cameras at the adult and puppy kennels let visitors see the animals live; a "Star of the Month" feature promotes priority adoptions.

chapters.title: Interactive Zone
chapters.text: VR headsets and a large screen show the animals in everyday scenes, so visitors get to know them before adopting.

ikea.badge: VIA 智慧城市 · 客戶案例影片
ikea.en: IKEA Taichung — B2B Customer Case Video
meta: 拍攝 · 剪輯 · 調色 · 腳本
ikea.overview: 協助智慧城市部門記錄 IKEA 台中店智慧叫號系統的導入過程，整理出實際的使用情境，透過鏡頭「轉譯」產品價值，做成一支有說服力的成功案例，讓更多潛在客戶看見解決方案帶來的效益。
ikea.challenge: B2B 客戶關注的重點不同：PM 端要講清楚產品應用與技術特點，IKEA 端則著重導入後的實際成效與使用回饋，影片架構需要同時滿足兩邊。
role: 跨團隊溝通：與 PM、企劃與 IKEA 窗口確認拍攝目標
現場拍攝：觀察並捕捉系統操作的關鍵細節
後期剪輯：把 B2B 技術流程整理成一看就懂的影片
全流程執行：從器材準備、現場引導到交片（訪談大綱由 PM 端訂定）

chapters.title: 現場拍攝
chapters.text: 除了訪談，也同步拍攝安裝、教學過程與現場使用的 B-roll，讓觀眾看懂導入的每個步驟與使用情境。

chapters.title: 產品機能視覺化
chapters.text: 用特寫鏡頭搭配動態圖解，說明自助機的功能、抗菌塗層與防碎保護。後製建立模組化素材、統一調色參數與字卡規範，確保系列影片一致。

chapters.title: 成果影片
chapters.text: 兩支影片分別從 PM 與 IKEA 的角度切入：產品應用與技術特點，以及導入後的成效與使用回饋。
videos: PM 觀點｜產品應用與技術特點
IKEA 觀點｜導入成效與使用回饋

en_content.badge: VIA Smart City · Customer Case Video
en_content.overview: Worked with VIA's Smart City division to document the rollout of a smart queuing system at IKEA Taichung. I captured how the system is actually used and translated its value on camera into a persuasive success story, so more prospective clients could see what the solution delivers.
en_content.challenge: The two stakeholders cared about different things: the PM side needed the applications and technical features explained clearly, while IKEA focused on real results and feedback after rollout. The structure had to serve both.
role: Cross-team coordination: aligned shoot goals with the PM, planning team and IKEA contact
On-site shooting: observed and captured the key details of how the system is operated
Editing: turned a B2B technical process into a video anyone can follow at a glance
End-to-end execution, from gear prep and on-site direction to final delivery (interview questions were set by the PM team)

chapters.title: On-site Shoot
chapters.text: Alongside the interviews, I shot B-roll of installation, staff training and everyday use, so viewers could follow each step of the rollout and see the system in context.

chapters.title: Visualizing Product Features
chapters.text: Close-ups combined with motion graphics explain the kiosk functions, antibacterial coating and shatter protection. In post, I built modular assets, unified color settings and title-card rules to keep the series consistent.

chapters.title: Final Videos
chapters.text: Two videos, each from a different angle: the PM's view on applications and technical features, and IKEA's view on results and user feedback.

mobile360.en: Mobile360 Forklift Safety — Installation & Calibration Guide
meta: 拍攝 · 剪輯 · 調色 · 腳本
mobile360.overview: 為 Mobile360 AI 堆高機安全系統，與產品行銷團隊合作製作標準化的安裝與校正教學。透過拍攝、特效註解與後製，把厚重的技術手冊轉成清楚直觀的影片，協助全球經銷商與使用者順利完成安裝。
mobile360.challenge: 原廠手冊雖然詳盡，但閱讀門檻與時間成本高；只靠文字與平面圖，經銷商很難理解佈線與校正流程，容易安裝錯誤或工時過長。
role: 與產品行銷團隊逐一確認安裝步驟，確保教學正確
場勘並規劃拍攝環境：銀色主機與黑色配件容易反光或吃光，特別挑選背景讓細節清楚
把安裝流程拆成 10 個拍攝單元，製作分鏡腳本
統一調色（LUTs）與字卡規範；初剪與 After Effects 片頭片尾由主管製作

chapters.title: 拍攝
chapters.text: 統一相機參數、拍攝時對照分鏡清單逐一確認，每天收工後過檔並雙重備份。

chapters.title: 成果影片
chapters.text: 10 支安裝教學影片，依步驟分段，經銷商可以隨選觀看。

en_content.overview: For the Mobile360 AI forklift safety system, I worked with the product marketing team to produce standardized installation and calibration tutorials. Through shooting, annotated effects and post-production, a dense technical manual became clear, intuitive videos that help distributors and users worldwide complete the installation.
en_content.challenge: The manual was thorough but slow and hard to read. With only text and diagrams, distributors struggled to follow the wiring and calibration steps, which led to installation errors and long labor hours.
role: Checked every installation step with the product marketing team to make sure the tutorials were accurate
Scouted and planned the set: the silver main unit and black accessories easily reflect or lose light, so I chose backgrounds that keep details legible
Split the installation process into 10 shooting units and wrote the storyboards
Unified color grading (LUTs) and title-card rules; the rough cut and After Effects intro/outro were done by my manager

chapters.title: Shooting
chapters.text: Fixed camera settings, checked every shot against the storyboard list on set, and offloaded footage with a double backup at the end of each day.

chapters.title: Final Videos
chapters.text: 10 installation tutorials, split by step so distributors can watch exactly the part they need.

smarthome.badge: VIA 智慧城市 · 情境影片
smarthome.en: VIA Smart Home — Scenario & Product Videos
meta: 腳本 · 拍攝 · 剪輯 · 調色
smarthome.overview: 原本的業務教材與 DM 多是技術規格，經銷商推廣 Smart Home IoT 產品串聯時，需要花很多時間口頭解釋。這個專案把產品的連動邏輯與使用情境轉成影像，讓客戶直接看懂系統怎麼運作。
smarthome.challenge: 產品之間的串聯與連動邏輯很難用文字呈現；要把操作邏輯轉成客戶聽得懂的生活語言，同時維持技術描述正確。
role: 與 FAE、RD 拆解產品連動邏輯，寫成情境腳本
規劃拍攝方案與現場素材，支援多版本剪輯
剪輯、調色與聲效，維持系列影片一致

chapters.title: 腳本與分鏡
chapters.text: 先用分鏡表規劃每一幕的畫面、拍攝細節與道具，再進行拍攝。

chapters.title: 成果
chapters.text: 產出「情境體驗」與「產品介紹」兩種影片，業務與經銷商可以依場合（展覽、提案、培訓）選用；產品串聯邏輯 1–2 分鐘就能說明完畢。
videos: VIA 智慧安居｜情境影片

en_content.overview: Existing sales materials and brochures were mostly technical specs, so distributors spent a lot of time explaining verbally how the Smart Home IoT products work together. This project turned those device interactions and everyday scenarios into video, so customers can see how the system works.
en_content.challenge: How the devices link and trigger each other is hard to describe in text. The operating logic had to become everyday language customers understand, while staying technically accurate.
role: Broke down device interactions with FAE and R&D, and wrote them up as scenario scripts
Planned the shoot and on-site footage to support multiple edit versions
Editing, color grading and sound, keeping the series consistent

chapters.title: Script & Storyboard
chapters.text: Planned the frame, shooting details and props for every scene on a storyboard sheet before the shoot.

chapters.title: Results
chapters.text: Two kinds of video, scenario and product introduction, that sales and distributors can pick by occasion (trade shows, pitches, training). How the products work together now takes 1–2 minutes to explain.

smarthome-guide.badge: VIA 智慧城市 · 教學影片
smarthome-guide.en: VIA Smart Home — Setup Tutorial Videos
meta: 腳本 · 剪輯 · 動態字卡
smarthome-guide.overview: 把 Smart Home 產品的安裝設定流程，從技術手冊轉成分段式的影音教學，讓經銷商與使用者能依需求找到對應步驟。
smarthome-guide.challenge: 原廠手冊冗長艱澀，施工現場也難以即時查閱；單靠文字與平面圖，難以呈現軟硬體設定細節，容易造成操作誤判、拉長部署工時。
role: 分析操作路徑，把冗長流程拆成獨立的教學段落並寫腳本
取得原生螢幕錄影素材，確認畫面與步驟正確
剪輯並用動態字卡與局部高亮標示關鍵操作點

chapters.title: 成果
chapters.text: 一套完整的 Master Guide，加上依功能拆分的模組化短片（保全系統、社區物業、監看、訊息通知、系統設定、通話功能），安裝時可以隨選即看。

en_content.overview: Turned the setup process for Smart Home products from a technical manual into segmented video tutorials, so distributors and users can find the exact step they need.
en_content.challenge: The manual was long and hard to consult on a job site. Text and diagrams alone could not show the hardware and software settings clearly, which led to mistakes and longer deployments.
role: Mapped the user path and split the long process into standalone tutorial segments with scripts
Sourced native screen recordings and checked that screens and steps were correct
Edited and used motion titles and local highlights to mark key actions

chapters.title: Results
chapters.text: A complete Master Guide plus modular short videos by feature (security, community property, monitoring, notifications, system settings, calling) that installers can pull up on demand.

via-web.en: VIA Website Redesign — UI & Information Architecture
meta: 資訊架構 · 線框圖 · Mockup · 介面樣式
via-web.overview: 配合威盛的品牌轉型參與官網 UI/UX 改版。舊網站架構無法承載新的「產業解決方案」定位，這次重新規劃了資訊分類與頁面呈現方式。
via-web.challenge: 公司策略聚焦車載安全系統，同時把智慧城市的顯示方案與智慧居家產品納入官網；產品從單一硬體跨到多元場域，需要一套能同時容納三類解決方案的資訊架構。
role: 盤點產品資料，依架構判斷各頁的資訊層級並編排
繪製線框圖與瀏覽路徑，從首頁順暢導到解決方案頁
蒐集參考、提出視覺提案並製作高保真 Mockup
以主管提供的色彩表為基礎，決定介面樣式與按鈕配色

chapters.title: 研究與參考
chapters.text: 改版前蒐集約 40 個車用、工業與科技品牌的官網，從資訊架構、導覽設計與版面節奏三個面向標註可借鏡的做法，整理成兩份參考文件，作為與團隊討論改版方向的依據。
images: 參考標註：資訊重點與指示設計
參考標註：選單分類與收納
參考標註：產品頁的資訊區塊

chapters.title: 功能地圖
chapters.text: 捨棄以「硬體規格」分類的邏輯，改以「解決方案」與「產業應用」為主軸建立導覽結構。

chapters.title: 模組化線框圖
chapters.text: 預先設計涵蓋所有使用情境的線框圖模組，不同資訊區塊可以標準化地快速套用，提升建置效率。

chapters.title: Mockup 與改版對照
chapters.text: 依線框圖繪製關鍵頁面 Mockup。改版後大量使用白底與卡片式版面，以 Overview、Features、Use Cases、Documentation 分段，讓頁面更專注在產品介紹與資源。

en_content.overview: Took part in the UI/UX redesign of the corporate website as part of VIA's rebrand. The old structure could not support the new industry-solutions positioning, so we re-planned how information is categorized and presented.
en_content.challenge: The company was focusing on in-vehicle safety systems while also bringing smart city display solutions and smart home products onto the site. With products spanning from single hardware to many settings, the site needed an information architecture that could hold all three solution lines.
role: Inventoried product content and set the information hierarchy for each page
Drew wireframes and user flows leading smoothly from the homepage to solution pages
Gathered references, proposed visual directions and built high-fidelity mockups
Worked from my manager's color sheet and decided the UI styles and button colors

chapters.title: Research & References
chapters.text: Before the redesign, I reviewed about 40 automotive, industrial and tech brand websites, annotated useful approaches to information architecture, navigation and layout rhythm, and compiled them into two reference documents to guide team discussions.
caps: Annotated reference: key info and cues

chapters.title: Site Map
chapters.text: Dropped the hardware-spec categories and rebuilt navigation around solutions and industry applications.

chapters.title: Modular Wireframes
chapters.text: Designed wireframe modules covering every use case in advance, so different information blocks could be applied quickly and consistently, speeding up the build.

chapters.title: Mockups & Before/After
chapters.text: Mockups of key pages based on the wireframes. The redesign uses white space and card layouts, with Overview, Features, Use Cases and Documentation sections keeping pages focused on the product and its resources.

via-next.badge: 威宏科技（VIA NEXT）· 官網
via-next.overview: 威盛集團子公司威宏科技（VIA NEXT）的官方網站建置。開發時程緊迫，由行銷部主導，在子公司既有的資訊架構與產品需求上，快速轉成可執行的線框圖，讓專案在高壓節奏下準確落地，也給開發端清楚的建置標準。
via-next.challenge: 從 0 到 1 建立數位門面；把長篇純文字整理成適合網頁閱讀的區塊；為了如期上線，直接進入線框圖並採用 Desktop-first。
role: 依既有架構把原始文字轉成頁面佈局，提高資訊可讀性
與前端開發即時同步，確認實作可行並微調互動方式

chapters.title: 主視覺
chapters.text: 以晶片與電路為主題的主視覺。

chapters.title: 線框圖
chapters.text: 首頁、核心能力、解決方案與關於我們等頁面的線框圖。

en_content.overview: Website build for VIA NEXT, a VIA subsidiary. The schedule was tight and led by the marketing team: I turned the subsidiary's existing information architecture and product needs into workable wireframes, so the project could land accurately under pressure with clear build standards for developers.
en_content.challenge: Building a digital presence from scratch; reshaping long plain text into web-friendly blocks; and, to launch on time, going straight to wireframes with a desktop-first approach.
role: Turned the source copy into page layouts within the existing structure, improving readability
Stayed in sync with front-end developers to confirm feasibility and fine-tune interactions

chapters.title: Key Visual
chapters.text: A key visual built on a chip-and-circuit theme.

chapters.title: Wireframes
chapters.text: Wireframes for the homepage, core capabilities, solutions and about pages.

skyrec.en: SkyREC Insight — BI Dashboard UX Optimization
meta: BI 數據分析系統 UX 優化
Persona · 功能地圖 · UI Flow · 線框圖
skyrec.overview: 在 SkyREC 實習期間參與 BI 數據分析系統 SkyREC Insight 的 UX 優化。當時版本功能多、介面資訊量過大，沒有依使用者的操作邏輯整理。我盤點原始的資訊架構與 UI Flow，找出核心痛點，用 Axure RP 設計一套標準化線框圖，作為之後改版的設計規範。
skyrec.challenge: 缺少具全局觀的 Dashboard，切換單店與多店數據時容易搞不清楚層級；功能與資訊密度高，操作路徑複雜；選單沒有分類，資訊同時出現造成視覺疲勞。
role: 調研主流數據分析系統，建立 Persona 定義優化順序
重組資訊架構與資料層級，適應不同職務的分析需求
繪製線框圖並重新規劃操作路徑，從 Dashboard 一路深入細部資料

chapters.title: Persona
chapters.text: 建立營運部經理、總經理、店長與數據分析師四種角色，作為與主管討論痛點與優先順序的基準。

chapters.title: 功能地圖與 UI Flow
chapters.text: 全面盤點原始功能，畫出功能地圖找出要簡化或重組的區塊，再把各頁面串成操作流程。

chapters.title: 線框圖與對照
chapters.text: 新增全局概覽的 Dashboard，登入後就能掌握關鍵指標；選單改為層級收摺，降低跨分店查詢的複雜度。
images: 首頁｜線框圖與原介面對照

rma.badge: VIA 智慧城市 · 流程文件設計
rma.en: VIA Smart Home — Shipping & RMA Documents
meta: 流程文件整理 · 資訊視覺化
出貨流程 · 保固政策 · SOP · 表單 · FAQ
rma.overview: 出貨與 RMA（退換貨維修）的規則由主管與相關部門訂定，我負責把這些規則整理成 5 份文件：釐清流程步驟與分支、統一格式，並用 InDesign 重新設計版面與流程圖，讓客戶與內部同仁都看得懂。
rma.challenge: 原本只有幾張樣式不一的流程圖，保固內外、付費與否等分支不容易看懂；同一套規則要同時給外部客戶與內部同仁使用，需要分開整理成不同版本。
role: 釐清流程步驟與分支，重畫成一致的流程圖
用 InDesign 設計文件版型，套用到 5 份文件
依對外、內部用途分別整理版本

chapters.title: 初期流程
chapters.text: 整理前的流程圖：資訊都在，但樣式不一，分支與附註不容易看懂。

en_content.overview: The shipping and RMA (return, replacement and repair) rules were set by management and the relevant departments. My job was to turn those rules into 5 documents: clarify the steps and branches, unify the format, and redesign the layouts and flowcharts in InDesign so both customers and internal staff could follow them.
en_content.challenge: There were only a few flowcharts in mixed styles, and branches such as in- vs. out-of-warranty or paid vs. free were hard to follow. The same rules served both external customers and internal staff, so they had to be organized into separate versions.
role: Clarified the steps and branches and redrew them as consistent flowcharts
Designed a document template in InDesign and applied it across all 5 documents
Organized separate external and internal versions

cabinet.badge: 課程作品 · 室內軟裝與 BIM 空間應用班
story: 練習目標
用 SketchUp 從零建出一件家具，並且出一套別人拿到就能看懂尺寸的圖。
做法
以三個獨立櫃體組合：兩側是木紋門片櫃，中間是開放層架。層板做成活動式，間距 30 cm，下方留 9 cm 踢腳。
成果
正反兩面透視、正視圖、俯視圖、側視圖與內部立面，總寬、總高與細部尺寸都標註清楚。

chapters.title: 透視圖
chapters.text: 正面與背面透視，確認三個櫃體的組合關係與材質。

chapters.title: 三視圖
chapters.text: 總寬 160 cm、總高 106 cm；俯視圖標示 40／80／40 cm 三個模組與深度 30 cm，側視圖標示層板間距。

chapters.title: 內部立面
chapters.text: 三層層板皆為活動式，間距 30 cm。

bedroom.badge: 課程作品 · 室內軟裝與 BIM 空間應用班
bedroom.en: Bedroom — From Survey to Construction Set
story: 練習目標
以一間臥室為對象，練習一個空間從現況到施工需要出哪些圖，以及每張圖之間怎麼對應。
做法
先畫現況圖確認牆體、門窗與淨尺寸，再依序完成平面配置、天花、燈具位置與迴路，最後用兩向立面交代床頭牆與衣櫃牆。
成果
七張圖、兩種比例，圖框、線型與標註方式統一，可以當成一套完整的圖組閱讀。

chapters.title: 現況／配置
chapters.text: 現況圖記錄牆體、門窗與淨尺寸；配置圖將雙人床靠主牆置中，兩側配置床頭櫃，對側整排衣櫃。

chapters.title: 天花
chapters.text: 四周天花高 240 cm，中央做 270 cm 挑高造型，左右退縮 49 cm、前後 76／92 cm。

chapters.title: 燈具位置與迴路
chapters.text: 挑高區配置四盞嵌燈，以 50／60 cm 定位；迴路圖以虛線標示開關與燈具的對應。

chapters.title: 立面
chapters.text: 床頭牆：中央直向線板造型搭配掛畫，兩側床頭櫃對稱；衣櫃牆：四門衣櫃高 230 cm，上方收納櫃，右側為房門。

bathroom.badge: 課程作品 · 室內軟裝與 BIM 空間應用班
story: 練習目標
練習用 1:20 的比例畫衛浴空間，讓平面與立面的尺寸彼此對得起來。
做法
寬 342 cm 的長型浴室，以隔間分為洗手區、馬桶區與浴缸區，標示各區寬度、設備定位與門的開啟方向。
成果
平面圖與立面圖各一張。立面標示樓高 300 cm、天花下淨高 245 cm，磁磚分割、鏡面與窗位都和平面對應。

chapters.title: 平面圖
chapters.text: 三區依序排開，標示各區寬度與設備位置。

chapters.title: 立面圖
chapters.text: 樓高 300 cm，天花下淨高 245 cm，窗高 130 cm。

studio-furniture.badge: 空間設計提案 · 板橋小套房
studio-furniture.en: Custom Furniture for the Banqiao Studio
story: 設計目標
板橋小套房實際住下來，收納不夠、床邊沒有地方放東西，現成家具的尺寸也放不進去。
做法
依空間和使用習慣，自己設計電視櫃、床頭櫃與衣櫃，畫出俯視、正視、側視與內部立面，標註板厚與層板間距。
成果
3 件家具的尺寸圖與渲染，可以直接拿去和木工或系統櫃廠商溝通。

chapters.title: F001 電視櫃
chapters.text: W110 × D40 × H50 cm。櫃體兩端倒圓角，經過時不易碰撞。上層格子加高到 20.3 cm，放得下 PS5，也留出散熱空間；背面開放讓主機散熱，隔板留穿線孔讓線材在格子之間穿過；中間下層設抽屜；底部採高腳設計，方便清掃。
images: F001 電視櫃｜俯視 · 正視 · 側視

chapters.title: F001 電視櫃｜空櫃與使用中
chapters.text: 45 度空櫃標出兩端圓角、背面開放、隔板穿線孔、抽屜與高腳；正面使用中的畫面則是左右兩格放 Switch、手把，中間上層放主機、下層是抽屜。
images: F001 電視櫃｜45 度空櫃（標註）
F001 電視櫃｜正面使用中

chapters.title: F002 床頭櫃
chapters.text: W44 × D30 × H55 cm。檯面與床墊同高，躺著伸手就拿得到。開口朝向走道，從浴室出來順手取用保養品；朝床一側封閉，維持睡眠區整潔。外角倒圓角 R10，開放側前角以金屬圓管支撐。
images: F002 床頭櫃｜俯視 · 正視 · 側視

chapters.title: F003 衣櫃
chapters.text: W90 × D60 × H190 cm。室內淨高 240 cm，衣櫃刻意不做到頂，上方留白放行李箱，降低壓迫感。左右拉門不佔開門空間；左格吊衣、右格層板加抽屜，中間隔板對齊拉門交界，打開一片門就能完整看到一格。
images: F003 衣櫃｜俯視 · 正視 · 內部立面
